in_arabic.name: صفوت
in_arabic.meaning: الصفوة من الاسماء التي تعبر عن النقاء و الصفاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم صفوت مشتق من الصفوة و هي جمع صفاة و تعني النقاء و الصفاء و الطهارة و يوحي بالشخصية النقية و الصافية و يعتبر من الاسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية عالية و تشير الى الشخص الذي يتمتع بقلب صاف و نقي

in_urdu.name: صفوت
in_urdu.meaning: صفوت کا مطلب ہے صفائی، خلوص اور طہارت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام صفوت عربی زبان کی اصطلاح صفوة سے ماخوذ ہے جو صفائی، خلوص اور طہارت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام پاکیزگی اور روحانی صفائی کی علامت ہے اور اسلامی روایت میں اس کا بڑا دینی اور ثقافتی اہمیت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: सिफ़वत
in_hindi.meaning: सिफ़वत का अर्थ है पवित्रता, शुद्धता और निर्मलता
in_hindi.long_meaning: सिफ़वत नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है पवित्रता, शुद्धता और निर्मलता। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है और यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए चुना जाता है जो स्वभाव से पवित्र और शुद्ध होते हैं।

in_pashto.name: صفوت
in_pashto.meaning: د صفوت نوم معنی پاکۍ، صفایي او طهارت دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: صفوت نوم د عربي کلمې صفوة څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې پاکۍ، صفایي او طهارت ته اشاره کوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانانو لپاره ډیر اهمیت لري او داسې سړی ته ورکول کیږي کوم چې طبیعتاً پاک او صاف وي.

in_english.meaning: Purity, cleanliness, and innocence are the meanings of this name

The name Sifwat is mentioned in various Islamic texts and is considered a blessed name that brings spiritual growth and enlightenment to its bearer.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Sifwat" holds cultural significance in the Islamic context as it reminds us of the concept of Zamzam - the holy water spring in Mecca that is a source of spiritual and physical nourishment for millions of pilgrims each year. Just as the Zamzam well is renowned for its life-giving properties, the name Sifwat conveys the idea of something pure, sustaining, and refreshing. The gentle flow of water in this name is reminiscent of the Prophet Muhammad's hadith, in which he is reported to have said, "The best among you are the ones whose manners and character most closely resemble those of the Prophets, and those who have the best names." By bearing this beautiful and meaningful name, an individual can be inspired to cultivate pure intentions and actions, reflecting the flowing, life-giving qualities of the name.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Sifwat" carries significant spiritual weight in Islamic tradition as it refers to the concept of 'overflowing goodness' or 'abundance'. In spiritual terms, the name reminds us of the unending blessings and mercies that come from Allah. It can inspire individuals to contemplate the vastness and abundance of Allah's mercy, which flows uninterrupted like a ceaseless river. Just as a river provides life-sustaining water to diverse creatures, Sifwat serves as a reminder that Allah's blessings are for all, regardless of race, creed, or social standing. Ultimately, this name encourages individuals to seek Allah's infinite blessings and abundant grace. As part of the divine Names of Allah, "Al-Mu'min" (the Protector), and "Al-Mun'im" (the Generous), Sifwat highlights the spiritual nourishment and support that come from faithfully following Allah. By living in the awareness of Allah's blessings encapsulated in this name, an individual can cultivate inner peace, contentment, and gratitude.
